SELECT
  SUM(s.ss_net_paid) AS denom,
  SUM(r.sr_return_amt) AS numer,
  round(SUM(r.sr_return_amt) / SUM(s.ss_net_paid) * 100, 2) AS rate
FROM (
  SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_net_paid
  FROM store_sales ss
  JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
  WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 9
) s
LEFT JOIN store_returns r
  ON r.sr_ticket_number = s.ss_ticket_number AND r.sr_item_sk = s.ss_item_sk;

SELECT SUM(ss.ss_net_paid) AS denom_all
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
WHERE d.d_year = 2002 AND d.d_moy = 9;

SELECT SUM(s.ss_net_paid) AS denom, SUM(r.sr_return_amt) AS numer, round(SUM(r.sr_return_amt)/SUM(s.ss_net_paid)*100,2) AS rate
FROM (SELECT ss.ss_ticket_number, ss.ss_item_sk, ss.ss_net_paid
      FROM store_sales ss JOIN date_dim d ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk=d.d_date_sk
      WHERE d.d_year=2002 AND d.d_moy=9) s
LEFT JOIN store_returns r ON r.sr_ticket_number=s.ss_ticket_number AND r.sr_item_sk=s.ss_item_sk;
